attack: The CAD-up complex (perma-bull, catalyst-junkie, value-guy, cross-merchant, positioning-cynic) is a pro-growth energy/ToT story. It treats minutes language and WTI as a BoC hike while Oct CORRA +1.5bp, labor 38, employment -42k, and core near 2% say Canada remains constrained. Saudi workaround reducing the extreme oil-supply tail is in the same packet as shock-absorber warnings, so the energy catalyst is two-sided.

AUD-up is only rate-hawk's side tag and is internally void: that seat refused to pay AU because the housing channel is already biting. AUDUSD is only 76.4th percentile 1y; short AUD fights ~50bp of AONIA-over-SOFR carry and can lose if an RBA abort is AUD-positive.

Paying US or Canada duration into 99th-percentile yields after a delivered Fed/BoJ week is the late-cycle policy-error the bear is fading. US labor 75 versus AU housing already in hard data is why Australia, not the US front end, is the defensive receive.
Spot AUDCAD/USDCAD cannot isolate the residual 51-60bp AONIA strip. Cross-merchant's own decomposition shows the 1m AUDCAD grind was CAD-weak versus USD, not an AUD-up growth case.
Complacent risk assets cited by the bull (SPX 90th, VIX 14.7th, HY 13.7th) argue fragility is underpriced. That supports receiving the most over-tightened housing cycle, not CAD-up.
defense: FACT: NSW stamp-duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, dwelling values >7% off peak; July employment -15.8k and unemployment 4.5% from 4.4%; September Westpac-MI sentiment -5.2% to 84.4; AU activity 54 / consumer 48 / labor 50. FACT: AONIA 4.35 still prices Oct 4.565 (+21.5bp), Dec 4.725 (+37.5bp), Mar-27 4.86 (+51bp) and a mid-2027 peak near 4.945 (+59.5bp). FACT: AU 2Y 4.999 is 99.0th percentile 1y. INFERENCE: that residual hike path is a policy error into an unfolding housing/labor downturn; long AU_2Y owns the unwind. CAD-up is a different, weaker mechanism. AUD-up is unsupported by the housing tape.

Rates remain the cleaner expression versus short AUDUSD (76.4th percentile 1y, carry-negative, pivot-positive AUD). Do not mix a pay-CA leg into labor 38; CA-AU 2Y 51st percentile 1y is not a crowded rates package that needs fading on the Canada side.

UNKNOWN: inflation dashboard 82 and unchanged 3.6% trimmed-mean CPI can still let the RBA look through housing (2025-12-22 and 2023-05-10 analog risk). Global tightening (SOFR still +75.25bp to Aug-28, BoJ 1.25%) can drag AU 2Y with US 2Y 4.76. Three of four same-move AU 2Y analogs continued higher; 2022-09-28 is one episode, not a base rate. CFTC nets remain null; no executable broker marks.

Concede if live AONIA holds or reprices above packet Oct-26 4.565 and Mar-27 4.86 while housing/labor stop deteriorating and/or trimmed-mean CPI re-accelerates from 3.6%. A delivered October hike with hawkish RBA guidance that lifts Dec 4.725 and Mar 4.86 also invalidates. A Canada energy-CPI catch-up that lifts CORRA beyond Dec 2.58 would not replace AU duration unless AU housing also heals. Trade unchanged; entry/target/stop remain packet-null.
holes_in_opposing_case: perma-bull CAD-up / pay CA_2Y treats activity 66 and BoC energy minutes as cyclical catch-up while the binding BoC facts are labor 38, employment -42k, core near 2%, and CORRA only +1.5bp by Oct / +29bp by Dec (2.58 vs overnight 2.29). The bull's closest same-regime analog (2026-04-01) forwarded CA 2Y -6bp over 3m. The same pitch concedes AU housing is already biting and Australia is not Canada's catch-up: that is a concession that long AU_2Y, not CAD-up, is the slowdown expression. SPX 90th / VIX 14.7th / HY OAS 13.7th in that pitch are complacent risk pricing, not proof CAD must rally.

catalyst-junkie CAD-up / pay COAZ26: the dated 14-18 Sep cluster (minutes, CPI 3%, Fed hike, BoJ hike) is already out and Oct CORRA is still +1.5bp. Failed transmission after the catalyst is evidence labor/core dominate, not that the strip is lagging. The CAD-up spot alternative fights a 156bp SOFR-CORRA overnight gap. The same pitch rejects receive-AONIA because housing is already in Oct AONIA +21.5bp, which concedes the housing channel is live and leaves the residual +51 to +59.5bp path as the remaining mispricing long AU_2Y owns.

value-guy CAD-up via long CA-US_2Y: PACKET_FACTS CFTC TFF nets are null (asset_manager_net, leveraged_net, dealer_net, chg_1w_net all null); the 1.73m AM-long / leveraged-short-CAD ownership story is not in the frozen TFF object. CA-US 2Y at -140bp versus overnight SOFR 3.85 / CORRA 2.29 (156bp) is the policy gap, not a 4th-percentile dislocation that must converge. The 2024-12-18 analog continued cheapening -20bp over 3m. Canada catch-up still has to clear labor 38 and core near 2%.

cross-merchant short AUDCAD needs CAD-up on energy ToT that the same room measures as a weak USDCAD-WTI residual (r-squared 0.017). Overnight carry AONIA 4.35 versus CORRA 2.29 (~206bp) bleeds the short. 1m AUDCAD +1.95% was mostly USDCAD +1.74% (CAD weak versus USD), not AUD strength. Housing-break lives in the still-priced +51 to +59.5bp AONIA path, not in a 99.8th-percentile FX screen.

positioning-cynic receive-AU is aligned; pay-CA / CAD-up is the hole. CAD OI 358186 is only 81.7th percentile 1y, not a light-positioned BoC-dove fade. CA-AU 2Y is 51st percentile 1y. Mixing pay-CA into labor 38 dilutes the housing-break duration long.

rate-hawk AUD_UP contradicts its own policy_path_check, which rejected paying AU because NSW stamp-duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values >7% off peak, and Dec AONIA volume is 2 contracts. AUD_UP is an unowned side tag with no AUD instrument. Hot US gauges (labor 75 / activity 69 / consumer 74) do not make AUD a growth currency into that housing slump. Paying SR1Z26 is a US-hike expression, not AUD-up.

trend-follower AU_RATES_UP: the same independent check calls AU housing the premature AU fade, then still tags AU rates higher. Paying US 2Y 4.76 (99.8th percentile 1y) after a >90% priced delivered hike is late-cycle continuation; the 2023-02 analog forwarded -70bp 1m / -50bp 3m. That is not a housing-break defensive trade.

dollar-king CAD-down / USD-up agrees on FX direction; the hole is au_rates_view higher. Long USDCAD does not own the residual AONIA path. Energy residual and a weak USDCAD-WTI link cut both ways and do not justify paying Australian duration.

carry-is-king inspected AONIA +51bp to Mar-27 and rejected receive-AU despite housing already contracting. Receive US 2Y / pay CA 2Y harvests US-hot versus CA-soft carry; it is not risk-off duration where the slowdown is visible. The pay-CA leg is the anti-bear Canada expression.

rate-dove is the same long AU_2Y instrument; the hole is bundling CA_RATES_DOWN as if CORRA +29bp were still too hawkish rather than already the labor-soft path. That is not a CAD-up case and does not require amending AU duration.

mean-reverter is the same long AU 2Y but as a 14bp overshoot fade (AU 2Y 4.999 versus Mar-27 AONIA 4.86), not a risk-off housing/policy-error mechanism. Three of four ~39bp 1m AU 2Y analogs continued higher; a percentile giveback is weaker than the housing-versus-path thesis.
